subject: Original PERST# GPIO slice for J293/T8103 main AP GPIO152
source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative path LF, sorted, over the five files below; report/log excluded

confirmed_pin_evidence.saved_ADT_evidence: Two saved actual J293 ADTs resolve pci-bridge0 function-perst to main provider phandle119, arguments152,0. These prior source findings are inherited, not a new hardware observation.

MIT_reference_pin_check: Both local files byte-compared with exact local pinned Git objects; no fetch, tracer import or experiment execution.

provenance.new_code: Original darwin-lab implementation and fake tests, no GPL source pasted or implementation reused.
provenance.register_facts: MIT trace/gpio.py: LOCK21, PERIPH6:5, MODE3:1, DATA0 and212 pin words at stride4. MIT speaker_amp.py:103-105 models another reset output with MODE1 and DATA low/high.
provenance.limits: The unrelated speaker example is not J293 GPIO152 runtime qualification. The active-low PERST# model does not reinterpret the ADT final argument0 as Linux GPIO flags or establish electrical inversion/ownership/timing.
provenance.license: Original project licensing remains pending; upstream provenance/relicensing unchanged.

implementation.API: apg_set_perst(const struct apg_io *, int asserted, struct apg_snapshot *)
implementation.fake_only_gate: Only APG_FAKE_GPIO_FILE compiles GPIO callback invocations. KERNEL plus APG_FAKE_GPIO_FILE is a compile error. APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE is refused in every mode, keeping existing shared PHY/PMGR write opt-in unavailable.
implementation.kernel_default_behavior: With valid arguments, returns APG_GATED with zero reads, writes and dirty=0, even if callbacks are supplied. No success stub and no real I/O implementation.
implementation.operation: Fixed pin152 only. Require unlocked existing PERIPH0/MODE1 output configuration. Assert clears DATA0; release sets DATA0. Preserve every other word bit and every sibling pin. One write, one readback; compare DATA/LOCK/PERIPH/MODE.
implementation.refusals: Locked pin, wrong mux/direction, invalid asserted value, missing fake callbacks, callback error or checked readback mismatch remain explicit failures.
implementation.ownership: Caller serializes stable callbacks/context. dirty set before attempted write, including errors after a backend may already have applied it. No rollback, retry, restore, pulse or implicit delay.
implementation.snapshot: Per-call partial observation with explicit before/after valid flags; failed read output remains zero. This is not a coherent hardware snapshot or ownership grant.
implementation.not_wired: No modification to old slices, apl_pins, IOKit adapter, CMake/Nix, target source tree or packet. No SMC/radio-enable, main-GPIO power or shared PHY/PMGR operation.
